verdict.rationale: Elastic's client docs state there is a wide range of official libraries for popular programming languages. They also document a forward-compatibility policy for those clients, and the quickstart invites users to index and search data in their preferred language. missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported SDK languages, per-SDK API reference depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Elasticsearch is easy to use from most popular programming languages, thanks to the wide range of official libraries and developer tools available.
The forward compatibility policy allows client applications to continue to work with the new server before the client itself is upgraded.
Create a project, then use your preferred language to index data and run semantic and hybrid searches in 10 minutes.
